payload.description:
Implements LIM-c32c24. Expose a small importable Python API, driven by behavior tests rather than CLI subprocesses.

Scope:
- Public functions for loading style config, diagnosing draft text, generating constrained options, recording decisions, and rendering annotations.
- Stable documented return shapes and domain-specific validation errors.
- Keep the CLI as a consumer of the same core.

Gherkin outcome:
Given a caller with draft text and local config
When it calls the public SDK
Then it receives the same validated diagnosis and options shapes as the CLI without a subprocess.

Definition of done:
- Public imports are intentional and tested.
- No Papyrus import, file mutation, or auto-apply.
- Behave plus direct SDK tests are green.
payload.title: Luna: define public SDK contracts from the shared core
